# Hyper-Scale Lab / Precalc Odyssey

> Free interactive precalculus self-study lab with story-based problems, graphs, worked solutions, and public study guides with diagrams.

## Site

- Home: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/
- Guides: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/
- Practice lab: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/hyper-scale/
- Login: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/login.html

## Public study guides

### Core
- What is precalculus?: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/what-is-precalculus.html
- Functions and transformations: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/functions-and-transformations.html
- Exponential and logarithmic functions: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/exponential-and-logarithmic-functions.html
- Trigonometry basics: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/trigonometry-basics.html

### AP-style (with diagrams)
- Polar coordinates: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/polar-coordinates.html
- Parametric equations: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/parametric-equations.html
- Matrices: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/matrices-intro.html
- Rates and limits: https://precalc-odyssey.pages.dev/guides/rates-and-limits.html

## Lab levels

- Standard: functions, poly/rational, exp/log, trigonometry
- Honors: sequences, conics, vectors, advanced trig
- AP: polar, parametric, matrices, rates & limits

## Pedagogy

Scenario context → numeric answer (3 attempts) → hints after 2nd miss → worked solution. Guides explain ideas in plain language with SVG diagrams; the lab practices them.
